## Meaning

This monitor fired because the signal changed faster than the configured percentage relative to its own recent history. Speed of degradation, not absolute level.

Query:

```
pct_change(avg(last_10m),last_1h):sum:acme.messaging.client_disconnects{__SCOPE__} by {service,namespace}.as_rate() > 200
```

## Impact

The service still functions but measurably worse; a subset of traffic or users is failing.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-messaging-delivery`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-messaging` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `consumer_group_state`, `dlq_sample`, `broker_metrics`.

Attached to the alert automatically: consumer group members, 5 sample DLQ messages, broker throughput.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `cloud-engineering` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P2 — ack within 10 minutes, escalate at 20.
